extraction.title: Unified Storage Performance Optimizations
extraction.head: unified-storage-enhancements

greptile.text: Summarizes the PR as performance optimizations for unified storage. Moves ResourceServer initialization from per-request server.Init() calls into construction in pkg/storage/unified/resource/server.go, and reorders setup so the search index is built before the watcher starts. Fixes tracer context propagation in search.go and sql/backend.go GetResourceStats, narrows the bleve.go cache lock to the final cache update, and skips a PostgreSQL test in CI. Confidence score 3/5, mainly due to a race condition risk in the bleve.go cache lock change.
logic: Race condition: Multiple goroutines can now build the same index simultaneously
